summary:
Yahoo’s front page still mixes search, mail and news under yahoo.com. The icon saved here is the one that host published, not the separate Yahoo Mail glyph.

Checked 12 November 2026 against yahoo.com. HTML came from https://www.yahoo.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon 48x48 → https://www.yahoo.com/favicon.ico?b0867f93a36b360e; icon any → https://s.yimg.com/cv/apiv2/default/favicon.ico; icon 512x512 → https://s.yimg.com/cv/apiv2/icons/yahoo.png; apple-touch-icon 512x512 → https://s.yimg.com/cv/apiv2/icons/yahoo.png.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.yahoo.com/favicon.ico?b0867f93a36b360e returned png (48×48, 664 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://s.yimg.com/cv/apiv2/icons/yahoo.png, measured at 512×512 png.

Brand colour #7722ff comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-512x512-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-512x512-01.png at 512×512 (png, 7728 bytes) from https://s.yimg.com/cv/apiv2/icons/yahoo.png.
